lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular white pixel clusters are visible on the lateral flank. The most prominent row contains six distinct spots spaced at regular intervals below the first carina.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a faint grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a high-contrast gradient with high-intensity luminance on the upper edge and low-intensity shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance yellow rectangular tag is affixed to the upper posterior margin of the dorsal fin. A thin, dark linear filament extends horizontally from the anterior mid-section of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The yellow artificial identification tag provides a unique spectral signature and geometric profile relative to the natural biological features.
